title: CA-HNM: Constraint-Aware Hard Negative Mining for Dense Retrieval with Structured Domain Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.35045v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dense retrievers are commonly trained with hard negatives selected from lexical or dense retrieval results. Retrieval proximity, however, does not indicate whether a candidate conflicts with explicit domain structure. We introduce CA-HNM, a constraint-aware hard-negative mining framework that combines retrieval-based candidate generation with deterministic incompatibility rules derived from a structured domain model. The framework removes known positives, constructs a local typed context around the query target, records relational, scope, target, and level mismatches, and uses the resulting candidates to fine-tune a standard dual encoder. Structured information is required only during offline negative construction. We evaluate CA-HNM on MOOCCubeX and Course-Skill Atlas with two encoders, two training losses, and ten seeds. Relative to a retrieval-rank-matched control, CA-HNM-Pure has higher mean NDCG@10 in six of eight dataset--encoder

translated_title: CA-HNM：基于结构化领域模型的约束感知难负例挖掘用于稠密检索
translated_abstract: 稠密检索器通常使用从词法检索或稠密检索结果中选取的难负例进行训练。然而，检索邻近度并不能表明候选样本是否与显式的领域结构相冲突。我们提出了CA-HNM，这是一个约束感知的难负例挖掘框架，它将基于检索的候选生成与从结构化领域模型推导出的确定性不兼容规则相结合。该框架移除已知的正例，围绕查询目标构建局部类型化上下文，记录关系、范围、目标和层级的错配情况，并使用由此产生的候选样本对标准双编码器进行微调。结构化信息仅在离线负例构建阶段需要。我们在MOOCCubeX和Course-Skill Atlas数据集上，使用两种编码器、两种训练损失和十个随机种子对CA-HNM进行了评估。相对于检索排名匹配的对照组，CA-HNM-Pure在八个数据集-编码器组合中的六个上取得了更高的平均NDCG@10。
tldr: CA-HNM通过将结构化领域模型的确定性不兼容规则与检索候选生成相结合，为稠密检索挖掘更符合领域结构约束的难负例，从而在多数数据集与编码器组合上提升了检索效果。
en_tdlr: CA-HNM is a constraint-aware hard negative mining framework that combines retrieval-based candidate generation with deterministic incompatibility rules from structured domain models, producing domain-consistent hard negatives that improve dense retrieval performance across most dataset-encoder combinations.
